title: Study 3: Ceftazidime/Avibactam Subcutaneous Administration
summary: Main objective: TDM of free ceftazidime concentrations on Days 3, 5, 7, and 10, with concurrent creatinine measurements.
conditions: Complicated intra-abdominal infection, complicated urinary tract infection including pyelonephritis, hospital-acquired pneumonia including ventilator-associated pneumonia, bacteraemia associated with the listed infections, and infections due to aerobic Gram-negative organisms in patients with limited treatment options

interventions.name: Zavicefta 2 g/0.5 g powder for concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Free, written and informed consent signed by the participant before any study-specific procedure. •	At least 18 years old on the day of inclusion. •	Male or female participant. •	Hospitalized in a medical ward (not ICU) authorized for enrolment in the study. •	Clinical indication for treatment with ceftazidime/avibactam, according to the treating physician and local antimicrobial practice. •	Initial intravenous ceftazidime/avibactam treatment started before enrolment or as part of the protocol Day 1 to Day 3 phase, with the patient considered eligible for subsequent switch to subcutaneous administration according to the study design. •	Creatinine clearance >50 mL/min at eligibility confirmation. For women of childbearing potential, negative pregnancy test before enrolment according to institutional procedures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. •	Known hypersensitivity to ceftazidime, avibactam, cephalosporins, other beta-lactam antibiotics, beta-lactamase inhibitors, or any component of the formulation. •	Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women intending to become pregnant during the study period. •	No ongoing clinical indication for ceftazidime/avibactam treatment at the time of eligibility confirmation. •	Known microbiological resistance to ceftazidime/avibactam when microbiological results are available before enrolment and the investigator considers CAZ-AVI no longer appropriate. •	Creatinine clearance <=50 mL/min at eligibility confirmation. •	Admission to an intensive care unit. •	Initiation of invasive or non-invasive mechanical ventilation. •	Initiation of renal replacement therapy or dialysis. •	Initiation of vasopressor support with norepinephrine/noradrenaline or an equivalent vasopressor. •	Any clinical condition, physical examination finding, metabolic dysfunction, or laboratory abnormality that contraindicates CAZ-AVI treatment, may interfere with interpretation of study results, or may expose the participant to unacceptable risk according to the investigator. •	Inability to comply with study procedures or follow-up requirements.
